description: AGSC-01-39 with AGSC-01-23: a second run of the SKOS import over the same file, into the Bundle the first run wrote, changes nothing. Derivation: the file of imp-0006 is imported twice; the first run writes the three items, the second run finds every planned path already holding exactly the bytes it would write, so it writes nothing, reports no AGSC-E206 collision and leaves the three files as they were (a path whose bytes are already what the import would write is unchanged, and is not a collision). The fixture is written for the purpose: it is not the example data of any site.
